title: Ethics, leakage and reproducibility evidence-control matrix
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Map material ethical, leakage, source, model, reproducibility and researcher-bias boundaries to preventive controls, retained records, stop/escalation rules and their exact current evidence states.

status.interpretation: Implemented/tested labels apply only to named repository mechanisms and selected local checks. Documented plans, unverified approvals and unavailable/sealed execution states remain separate and cannot supply empirical outcomes.

placement.deliberate_break: After the fourth control family, before prompt-injection/model controls.
placement.integration: Input immediately after Section 3.7 prose and before Chapter 4 or the next heading.

standalone_a4.visual_inspection: Both table pages are legible with repeated headers, intact rules, no overlap or clipping, and balanced four-row/three-row pagination.
standalone_a4.scoped_warnings: Five non-material longtable measurement-pass underfull alignment messages; repository inputenc-on-XeTeX warning; absolute-path warnings belong only to the disposable validation harness.

control_traceability.status: Mechanisms implemented/tested; real-data authority, retention/deletion schedule and credential rotation not verified; no restricted external execution.
Approval evidence not verified; no-go; participant and qualitative executions unavailable.
D0 mechanism implemented/tested; D1 protocol-only; D2 sealed and loader-blocked; no D1/D2 result.
Bounded controls implemented; local public-web use conditional and source-specific; direct registry evaluation and redistribution held/unavailable.
Mechanisms implemented/tested; no D1/D2/participant processing and no model-quality, retention-control or superiority result.
Observability and D0 repeat mechanisms implemented/tested; final empirical run bundle unavailable.
Documented plan; gold/reference and final protocol not frozen; confirmatory/human execution unavailable.

limitations: The exhibit is conceptual and reports no empirical finding, effect, sample, participant, time, cost or acceptance threshold.
Implemented mechanisms and selected local tests do not establish ethics compliance, lawful source use, absence of leakage, security effectiveness, reproducibility, validity or production readiness.
Approval evidence not verified is an epistemic and operational no-go state; it is not a claim that an external body granted or refused approval.
D1, D2, human C0 and human C3 executions are unavailable and cannot be replaced with D0 synthetic measurements.
The bounded public-web mechanism and source register do not create publisher redistribution rights or exhaustive coverage.
store=False is not represented as zero data retention and does not replace processor authority or minimisation.
The final reproducibility bundle, reference, analysis and deviation records remain prospective until authorised protocol execution.
